verses.arabic: قَدْ أَفْلَحَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.english: Certainly, the faithful have attained salvation
verses.transliteration_html: Qad aflaha almuminoona
verses.transliteration_text: Qad aflaha almuminoona

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ فِى صَلَاتِهِمْ خَـٰشِعُونَ
verses.english: —those who are humble in their prayers,
verses.transliteration_html: Allatheena hum fee salatihim khashiAAoona
verses.transliteration_text: Allatheena hum fee salatihim khashiAAoona

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ عَنِ ٱللَّغْوِ مُعْرِضُونَ
verses.english: avoid vain talk,
verses.transliteration_html: Waallatheena hum AAani allaghwi muAAridoona
verses.transliteration_text: Waallatheena hum AAani allaghwi muAAridoona

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ لِلزَّكَوٰةِ فَـٰعِلُونَ
verses.english: carry out their [duty of] zakat,
verses.transliteration_html: Waallatheena hum lilzzakati faAAiloona
verses.transliteration_text: Waallatheena hum lilzzakati faAAiloona

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ لِفُرُوجِهِمْ حَـٰفِظُونَ
verses.english: guard their private parts,
verses.transliteration_html: Waallatheena hum lifuroojihim hafithoona
verses.transliteration_text: Waallatheena hum lifuroojihim hafithoona

verses.arabic: إِلَّا عَلَىٰٓ أَزْوَٰجِهِمْ أَوْ مَا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَـٰنُهُمْ فَإِنَّهُمْ غَيْرُ مَلُومِينَ
verses.english: (except from their spouses or their slave women, for then they are not blameworthy;
verses.transliteration_html: Illa AAala azwajihim aw ma malakat aymanuhum fainnahum ghayru maloomeena
verses.transliteration_text: Illa AAala azwajihim aw ma malakat aymanuhum fainnahum ghayru maloomeena

verses.arabic: فَمَنِ ٱبْتَغَىٰ وَرَآءَ ذَٰلِكَ فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْعَادُونَ
verses.english: but whoever seeks [anything] beyond that—it is they who are transgressors),
verses.transliteration_html: Famani ibtagha waraa thalika faolaika humu alAAadoona
verses.transliteration_text: Famani ibtagha waraa thalika faolaika humu alAAadoona

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ لِأَمَـٰنَـٰتِهِمْ وَعَهْدِهِمْ رَٰعُونَ
verses.english: and those who keep their trusts and covenants
verses.transliteration_html: Waallatheena hum liamanatihim waAAahdihim raAAoona
verses.transliteration_text: Waallatheena hum liamanatihim waAAahdihim raAAoona

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ عَلَىٰ صَلَوَٰتِهِمْ يُحَافِظُونَ
verses.english: and are watchful of their prayers.
verses.transliteration_html: Waallatheena hum AAala salawatihim yuhafithoona
verses.transliteration_text: Waallatheena hum AAala salawatihim yuhafithoona

verses.arabic: أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْوَٰرِثُونَ
verses.english: It is they who will be the inheritors,
verses.transliteration_html: Olaika humu alwarithoona
verses.transliteration_text: Olaika humu alwarithoona

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يَرِثُونَ ٱلْفِرْدَوْسَ هُمْ فِيهَا خَـٰلِدُونَ
verses.english: who shall inherit paradise and will remain in it [forever].
verses.transliteration_html: Allatheena yarithoona alfirdawsa hum feeha khalidoona
verses.transliteration_text: Allatheena yarithoona alfirdawsa hum feeha khalidoona

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ مِن سُلَـٰلَةٍۢ مِّن طِينٍۢ
verses.english: Certainly We created man from an extract of clay.
verses.transliteration_html: Walaqad khalaqna alinsana min sulalatin min teenin
verses.transliteration_text: Walaqad khalaqna alinsana min sulalatin min teenin

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ جَعَلْنَـٰهُ نُطْفَةًۭ فِى قَرَارٍۢ مَّكِينٍۢ
verses.english: Then We made him a drop of [seminal] fluid [lodged] in a secure abode.
verses.transliteration_html: Thumma jaAAalnahu nutfatan fee qararin makeenin
verses.transliteration_text: Thumma jaAAalnahu nutfatan fee qararin makeenin

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ خَلَقْنَا ٱلنُّطْفَةَ عَلَقَةًۭ فَخَلَقْنَا ٱلْعَلَقَةَ مُضْغَةًۭ فَخَلَقْنَا ٱلْمُضْغَةَ عِظَـٰمًۭا فَكَسَوْنَا ٱلْعِظَـٰمَ لَحْمًۭا ثُمَّ أَنشَأْنَـٰهُ خَلْقًا ءَاخَرَ ۚ فَتَبَارَكَ ٱللَّهُ أَحْسَنُ ٱلْخَـٰلِقِينَ
verses.english: Then We created the drop of fluid as a clinging mass. Then We created the clinging mass as a fleshy tissue. Then We created the fleshy tissue as bones. Then We clothed the bones with flesh. Then We produced him as [yet] another creature. So blessed is Allah, the best of creators!
verses.transliteration_html: Thumma khalaqna alnnutfata AAalaqatan fakhalaqna alAAalaqata mudghatan fakhalaqna almudghata AAithaman fakasawna alAAithama lahman thumma anshanahu khalqan akhara fatabaraka Allahu ahsanu alkhaliqeena
verses.transliteration_text: Thumma khalaqna alnnutfata AAalaqatan fakhalaqna alAAalaqata mudghatan fakhalaqna almudghata AAithaman fakasawna alAAithama lahman thumma anshanahu khalqan akhara fatabaraka Allahu ahsanu alkhaliqeena

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ إِنَّكُم بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ لَمَيِّتُونَ
verses.english: Then indeed you die after that.
verses.transliteration_html: Thumma innakum baAAda thalika lamayyitoona
verses.transliteration_text: Thumma innakum baAAda thalika lamayyitoona

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ إِنَّكُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ تُبْعَثُونَ
verses.english: Then you will indeed be raised up on the Day of Resurrection.
verses.transliteration_html: Thumma innakum yawma alqiyamati tubAAathoona
verses.transliteration_text: Thumma innakum yawma alqiyamati tubAAathoona

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا فَوْقَكُمْ سَبْعَ طَرَآئِقَ وَمَا كُنَّا عَنِ ٱلْخَلْقِ غَـٰفِلِينَ
verses.english: Certainly We created above you seven levels and We have not been oblivious of the creation.
verses.transliteration_html: Walaqad khalaqna fawqakum sabAAa taraiqa wama kunna AAani alkhalqi ghafileena
verses.transliteration_text: Walaqad khalaqna fawqakum sabAAa taraiqa wama kunna AAani alkhalqi ghafileena

verses.arabic: وَأَنزَلْنَا مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءًۢ بِقَدَرٍۢ فَأَسْكَنَّـٰهُ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ وَإِنَّا عَلَىٰ ذَهَابٍۭ بِهِۦ لَقَـٰدِرُونَ
verses.english: We sent down water from the sky in a measured manner, and We lodged it within the ground, and We are indeed able to take it away.
verses.transliteration_html: Waanzalna mina alssamai maan biqadarin faaskannahu fee alardi wainna AAala thahabin bihi laqadiroona
verses.transliteration_text: Waanzalna mina alssamai maan biqadarin faaskannahu fee alardi wainna AAala thahabin bihi laqadiroona

verses.arabic: فَأَنشَأْنَا لَكُم بِهِۦ جَنَّـٰتٍۢ مِّن نَّخِيلٍۢ وَأَعْنَـٰبٍۢ لَّكُمْ فِيهَا فَوَٰكِهُ كَثِيرَةٌۭ وَمِنْهَا تَأْكُلُونَ
verses.english: Then with it We produced for you gardens of date palms and vines. There are abundant fruits in them for you, and you eat from them,
verses.transliteration_html: Faanshana lakum bihi jannatin min nakheelin waaAAnabin lakum feeha fawakihu katheeratun waminha takuloona
verses.transliteration_text: Faanshana lakum bihi jannatin min nakheelin waaAAnabin lakum feeha fawakihu katheeratun waminha takuloona

verses.arabic: وَشَجَرَةًۭ تَخْرُجُ مِن طُورِ سَيْنَآءَ تَنۢبُتُ بِٱلدُّهْنِ وَصِبْغٍۢ لِّلْـَٔاكِلِينَ
verses.english: and a tree that grows on Mount Sinai, which produces oil and a seasoning for those who eat.
verses.transliteration_html: Washajaratan takhruju min toori saynaa tanbutu bialdduhni wasibghin lilakileena
verses.transliteration_text: Washajaratan takhruju min toori saynaa tanbutu bialdduhni wasibghin lilakileena

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّ لَكُمْ فِى ٱلْأَنْعَـٰمِ لَعِبْرَةًۭ ۖ نُّسْقِيكُم مِّمَّا فِى بُطُونِهَا وَلَكُمْ فِيهَا مَنَـٰفِعُ كَثِيرَةٌۭ وَمِنْهَا تَأْكُلُونَ
verses.english: There is indeed a moral for you in the cattle: We give you to drink of that which is in their bellies, and you have many uses in them, and you eat some of them,
verses.transliteration_html: Wainna lakum fee alanAAami laAAibratan nusqeekum mimma fee butooniha walakum feeha manafiAAu katheeratun waminha takuloona
verses.transliteration_text: Wainna lakum fee alanAAami laAAibratan nusqeekum mimma fee butooniha walakum feeha manafiAAu katheeratun waminha takuloona

verses.arabic: وَعَلَيْهَا وَعَلَى ٱلْفُلْكِ تُحْمَلُونَ
verses.english: and you are carried on them and on ships.
verses.transliteration_html: WaAAalayha waAAala alfulki tuhmaloona
verses.transliteration_text: WaAAalayha waAAala alfulki tuhmaloona

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًا إِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦ فَقَالَ يَـٰقَوْمِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ مَا لَكُم مِّنْ إِلَـٰهٍ غَيْرُهُۥٓ ۖ أَفَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
verses.english: Certainly We sent Noah to his people, and he said, ‘O my people! Worship Allah! You have no other god besides Him. Will you not then be wary [of Him]?’
verses.transliteration_html: Walaqad arsalna noohan ila qawmihi faqala ya qawmi oAAbudoo Allaha ma lakum min ilahin ghayruhu afala tattaqoona
verses.transliteration_text: Walaqad arsalna noohan ila qawmihi faqala ya qawmi oAAbudoo Allaha ma lakum min ilahin ghayruhu afala tattaqoona

verses.arabic: فَقَالَ ٱلْمَلَؤُا۟ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِن قَوْمِهِۦ مَا هَـٰذَآ إِلَّا بَشَرٌۭ مِّثْلُكُمْ يُرِيدُ أَن يَتَفَضَّلَ عَلَيْكُمْ وَلَوْ شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ لَأَنزَلَ مَلَـٰٓئِكَةًۭ مَّا سَمِعْنَا بِهَـٰذَا فِىٓ ءَابَآئِنَا ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
verses.english: But the elite of the faithless from among his people said, ‘This is just a human being like you, who seeks to dominate you. Had Allah wished, He would have sent down angels. We never heard of such a thing among our forefathers.
verses.transliteration_html: Faqala almalao allatheena kafaroo min qawmihi ma hatha illa basharun mithlukum yureedu an yatafaddala AAalaykum walaw shaa Allahu laanzala malaikatan ma samiAAna bihatha fee abaina alawwaleena
verses.transliteration_text: Faqala almalao allatheena kafaroo min qawmihi ma hatha illa basharun mithlukum yureedu an yatafaddala AAalaykum walaw shaa Allahu laanzala malaikatan ma samiAAna bihatha fee abaina alawwaleena

verses.arabic: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا رَجُلٌۢ بِهِۦ جِنَّةٌۭ فَتَرَبَّصُوا۟ بِهِۦ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍۢ
verses.english: He is just a man possessed by madness. So bear with him for a while.’
verses.transliteration_html: In huwa illa rajulun bihi jinnatun fatarabbasoo bihi hatta heenin
verses.transliteration_text: In huwa illa rajulun bihi jinnatun fatarabbasoo bihi hatta heenin

verses.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱنصُرْنِى بِمَا كَذَّبُونِ
verses.english: He said, ‘My Lord! Help me, for they impugn me.’
verses.transliteration_html: Qala rabbi onsurnee bima kaththabooni
verses.transliteration_text: Qala rabbi onsurnee bima kaththabooni

verses.arabic: فَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَيْهِ أَنِ ٱصْنَعِ ٱلْفُلْكَ بِأَعْيُنِنَا وَوَحْيِنَا فَإِذَا جَآءَ أَمْرُنَا وَفَارَ ٱلتَّنُّورُ ۙ فَٱسْلُكْ فِيهَا مِن كُلٍّۢ زَوْجَيْنِ ٱثْنَيْنِ وَأَهْلَكَ إِلَّا مَن سَبَقَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلْقَوْلُ مِنْهُمْ ۖ وَلَا تُخَـٰطِبْنِى فِى ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوٓا۟ ۖ إِنَّهُم مُّغْرَقُونَ
verses.english: So We revealed to him: ‘Build the ark before Our eyes and by Our revelation. When Our edict comes and the oven gushes [a stream of water], bring into it a pair of every kind [of animal], and your family, except those of them against whom the decree has gone beforehand, and do not plead with Me for those who are wrongdoers: they shall indeed be drowned.’
verses.transliteration_html: Faawhayna ilayhi ani isnaAAi alfulka biaAAyunina wawahyina faitha jaa amruna wafara alttannooru faosluk feeha min kullin zawjayni ithnayni waahlaka illa man sabaqa AAalayhi alqawlu minhum wala tukhatibnee fee allatheena thalamoo innahum mughraqoona
verses.transliteration_text: Faawhayna ilayhi ani isnaAAi alfulka biaAAyunina wawahyina faitha jaa amruna wafara alttannooru faosluk feeha min kullin zawjayni ithnayni waahlaka illa man sabaqa AAalayhi alqawlu minhum wala tukhatibnee fee allatheena thalamoo innahum mughraqoona

verses.arabic: فَإِذَا ٱسْتَوَيْتَ أَنتَ وَمَن مَّعَكَ عَلَى ٱلْفُلْكِ فَقُلِ ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِى نَجَّىٰنَا مِنَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
verses.english: ‘When you, and those who are with you, are settled in the ark, say, ‘‘All praise belongs to Allah, who has delivered us from the wrongdoing lot.’’
verses.transliteration_html: Faitha istawayta anta waman maAAaka AAala alfulki faquli alhamdu lillahi allathee najjana mina alqawmi alththalimeena
verses.transliteration_text: Faitha istawayta anta waman maAAaka AAala alfulki faquli alhamdu lillahi allathee najjana mina alqawmi alththalimeena

verses.arabic: وَقُل رَّبِّ أَنزِلْنِى مُنزَلًۭا مُّبَارَكًۭا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ ٱلْمُنزِلِينَ
verses.english: And say, ‘‘My Lord! Land me with a blessed landing, for You are the best of those who bring ashore.’’ ’
verses.transliteration_html: Waqul rabbi anzilnee munzalan mubarakan waanta khayru almunzileena
verses.transliteration_text: Waqul rabbi anzilnee munzalan mubarakan waanta khayru almunzileena

verses.arabic: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَـٰتٍۢ وَإِن كُنَّا لَمُبْتَلِينَ
verses.english: There are indeed signs in this; and indeed, We have been testing.
verses.transliteration_html: Inna fee thalika laayatin wain kunna lamubtaleena
verses.transliteration_text: Inna fee thalika laayatin wain kunna lamubtaleena

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ أَنشَأْنَا مِنۢ بَعْدِهِمْ قَرْنًا ءَاخَرِينَ
verses.english: Then after them We brought forth another generation,
verses.transliteration_html: Thumma anshana min baAAdihim qarnan akhareena
verses.transliteration_text: Thumma anshana min baAAdihim qarnan akhareena

verses.arabic: فَأَرْسَلْنَا فِيهِمْ رَسُولًۭا مِّنْهُمْ أَنِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ مَا لَكُم مِّنْ إِلَـٰهٍ غَيْرُهُۥٓ ۖ أَفَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
verses.english: and We sent them an apostle from among themselves, saying, ‘Worship Allah! You have no other god besides Him. Will you not then be wary [of Him]?’
verses.transliteration_html: Faarsalna feehim rasoolan minhum ani oAAbudoo Allaha ma lakum min ilahin ghayruhu afala tattaqoona
verses.transliteration_text: Faarsalna feehim rasoolan minhum ani oAAbudoo Allaha ma lakum min ilahin ghayruhu afala tattaqoona

verses.arabic: وَقَالَ ٱلْمَلَأُ مِن قَوْمِهِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَكَذَّبُوا۟ بِلِقَآءِ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ وَأَتْرَفْنَـٰهُمْ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا مَا هَـٰذَآ إِلَّا بَشَرٌۭ مِّثْلُكُمْ يَأْكُلُ مِمَّا تَأْكُلُونَ مِنْهُ وَيَشْرَبُ مِمَّا تَشْرَبُونَ
verses.english: Said the elite of his people, who were faithless and who denied the encounter of the Hereafter and whom We had given affluence in the life of the world: ‘This is just a human being like yourselves: he eats what you eat, and drinks what you drink.
verses.transliteration_html: Waqala almalao min qawmihi allatheena kafaroo wakaththaboo biliqai alakhirati waatrafnahum fee alhayati alddunya ma hatha illa basharun mithlukum yakulu mimma takuloona minhu wayashrabu mimma tashraboona
verses.transliteration_text: Waqala almalao min qawmihi allatheena kafaroo wakaththaboo biliqai alakhirati waatrafnahum fee alhayati alddunya ma hatha illa basharun mithlukum yakulu mimma takuloona minhu wayashrabu mimma tashraboona

verses.arabic: وَلَئِنْ أَطَعْتُم بَشَرًۭا مِّثْلَكُمْ إِنَّكُمْ إِذًۭا لَّخَـٰسِرُونَ
verses.english: If you obey a human being like yourselves, you will indeed be losers.
verses.transliteration_html: Walain ataAAtum basharan mithlakum innakum ithan lakhasiroona
verses.transliteration_text: Walain ataAAtum basharan mithlakum innakum ithan lakhasiroona

verses.arabic: أَيَعِدُكُمْ أَنَّكُمْ إِذَا مِتُّمْ وَكُنتُمْ تُرَابًۭا وَعِظَـٰمًا أَنَّكُم مُّخْرَجُونَ
verses.english: Does he promise you that when you have died and become bones and dust you will indeed be raised [from the dead]?
verses.transliteration_html: AyaAAidukum annakum itha mittum wakuntum turaban waAAithaman annakum mukhrajoona
verses.transliteration_text: AyaAAidukum annakum itha mittum wakuntum turaban waAAithaman annakum mukhrajoona

verses.arabic: ۞ هَيْهَاتَ هَيْهَاتَ لِمَا تُوعَدُونَ
verses.english: Far-fetched, far-fetched is what you are promised!
verses.transliteration_html: Hayhata hayhata lima tooAAadoona
verses.transliteration_text: Hayhata hayhata lima tooAAadoona

verses.arabic: إِنْ هِىَ إِلَّا حَيَاتُنَا ٱلدُّنْيَا نَمُوتُ وَنَحْيَا وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَبْعُوثِينَ
verses.english: There is nothing but the life of this world: we live and die, and we will not be resurrected.
verses.transliteration_html: In hiya illa hayatuna alddunya namootu wanahya wama nahnu bimabAAootheena
verses.transliteration_text: In hiya illa hayatuna alddunya namootu wanahya wama nahnu bimabAAootheena

verses.arabic: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا رَجُلٌ ٱفْتَرَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًۭا وَمَا نَحْنُ لَهُۥ بِمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.english: He is just a man who has fabricated a lie against Allah, and we will not believe in him.’
verses.transliteration_html: In huwa illa rajulun iftara AAala Allahi kathiban wama nahnu lahu bimumineena
verses.transliteration_text: In huwa illa rajulun iftara AAala Allahi kathiban wama nahnu lahu bimumineena

verses.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱنصُرْنِى بِمَا كَذَّبُونِ
verses.english: He said, ‘My Lord! Help me, for they impugn me.’
verses.transliteration_html: Qala rabbi onsurnee bima kaththabooni
verses.transliteration_text: Qala rabbi onsurnee bima kaththabooni

verses.arabic: قَالَ عَمَّا قَلِيلٍۢ لَّيُصْبِحُنَّ نَـٰدِمِينَ
verses.english: Said He, ‘In a little while they will become regretful.’
verses.transliteration_html: Qala AAamma qaleelin layusbihunna nadimeena
verses.transliteration_text: Qala AAamma qaleelin layusbihunna nadimeena

verses.arabic: فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلصَّيْحَةُ بِٱلْحَقِّ فَجَعَلْنَـٰهُمْ غُثَآءًۭ ۚ فَبُعْدًۭا لِّلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
verses.english: So the Cry seized them justly and We turned them into a scum. So away with the wrongdoing lot!
verses.transliteration_html: Faakhathathumu alssayhatu bialhaqqi fajaAAalnahum ghuthaan fabuAAdan lilqawmi alththalimeena
verses.transliteration_text: Faakhathathumu alssayhatu bialhaqqi fajaAAalnahum ghuthaan fabuAAdan lilqawmi alththalimeena

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ أَنشَأْنَا مِنۢ بَعْدِهِمْ قُرُونًا ءَاخَرِينَ
verses.english: Then after them We brought forth other generations.
verses.transliteration_html: Thumma anshana min baAAdihim quroonan akhareena
verses.transliteration_text: Thumma anshana min baAAdihim quroonan akhareena

verses.arabic: مَا تَسْبِقُ مِنْ أُمَّةٍ أَجَلَهَا وَمَا يَسْتَـْٔخِرُونَ
verses.english: No nation can advance its time nor can it defer it.
verses.transliteration_html: Ma tasbiqu min ommatin ajalaha wama yastakhiroona
verses.transliteration_text: Ma tasbiqu min ommatin ajalaha wama yastakhiroona

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ أَرْسَلْنَا رُسُلَنَا تَتْرَا ۖ كُلَّ مَا جَآءَ أُمَّةًۭ رَّسُولُهَا كَذَّبُوهُ ۚ فَأَتْبَعْنَا بَعْضَهُم بَعْضًۭا وَجَعَلْنَـٰهُمْ أَحَادِيثَ ۚ فَبُعْدًۭا لِّقَوْمٍۢ لَّا يُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.english: Then We sent Our apostles successively. Whenever there came to a nation its apostle, they impugned him, so We made them follow one another [to extinction] and We turned them into folktales. So away with the faithless lot!
verses.transliteration_html: Thumma arsalna rusulana tatra kulla ma jaa ommatan rasooluha kaththaboohu faatbaAAna baAAdahum baAAdan wajaAAalnahum ahadeetha fabuAAdan liqawmin la yuminoona
verses.transliteration_text: Thumma arsalna rusulana tatra kulla ma jaa ommatan rasooluha kaththaboohu faatbaAAna baAAdahum baAAdan wajaAAalnahum ahadeetha fabuAAdan liqawmin la yuminoona

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ أَرْسَلْنَا مُوسَىٰ وَأَخَاهُ هَـٰرُونَ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا وَسُلْطَـٰنٍۢ مُّبِينٍ
verses.english: Then We sent Moses and Aaron, his brother, with Our signs and a manifest authority
verses.transliteration_html: Thumma arsalna moosa waakhahu haroona biayatina wasultanin mubeenin
verses.transliteration_text: Thumma arsalna moosa waakhahu haroona biayatina wasultanin mubeenin

verses.arabic: إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَإِي۟هِۦ فَٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ وَكَانُوا۟ قَوْمًا عَالِينَ
verses.english: to Pharaoh and his elites; but they acted arrogantly and they were a tyrannical lot.
verses.transliteration_html: Ila firAAawna wamalaihi faistakbaroo wakanoo qawman AAaleena
verses.transliteration_text: Ila firAAawna wamalaihi faistakbaroo wakanoo qawman AAaleena

verses.arabic: فَقَالُوٓا۟ أَنُؤْمِنُ لِبَشَرَيْنِ مِثْلِنَا وَقَوْمُهُمَا لَنَا عَـٰبِدُونَ
verses.english: They said, ‘Shall we believe two humans like ourselves, while their people are our slaves?’
verses.transliteration_html: Faqaloo anuminu libasharayni mithlina waqawmuhuma lana AAabidoona
verses.transliteration_text: Faqaloo anuminu libasharayni mithlina waqawmuhuma lana AAabidoona

verses.arabic: فَكَذَّبُوهُمَا فَكَانُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلْمُهْلَكِينَ
verses.english: So they impugned the two of them, whereat they were among those who were destroyed.
verses.transliteration_html: Fakaththaboohuma fakanoo mina almuhlakeena
verses.transliteration_text: Fakaththaboohuma fakanoo mina almuhlakeena

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا مُوسَى ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَهْتَدُونَ
verses.english: Certainly We gave Moses the Book so that they might be guided,
verses.transliteration_html: Walaqad atayna moosa alkitaba laAAallahum yahtadoona
verses.transliteration_text: Walaqad atayna moosa alkitaba laAAallahum yahtadoona

verses.arabic: وَجَعَلْنَا ٱبْنَ مَرْيَمَ وَأُمَّهُۥٓ ءَايَةًۭ وَءَاوَيْنَـٰهُمَآ إِلَىٰ رَبْوَةٍۢ ذَاتِ قَرَارٍۢ وَمَعِينٍۢ
verses.english: and We made the son of Mary and his mother a sign, and sheltered them in a level highland with flowing water.
verses.transliteration_html: WajaAAalna ibna maryama waommahu ayatan waawaynahuma ila rabwatin thati qararin wamaAAeenin
verses.transliteration_text: WajaAAalna ibna maryama waommahu ayatan waawaynahuma ila rabwatin thati qararin wamaAAeenin

verses.arabic: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلرُّسُلُ كُلُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلطَّيِّبَـٰتِ وَٱعْمَلُوا۟ صَـٰلِحًا ۖ إِنِّى بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ عَلِيمٌۭ
verses.english: O apostles! Eat of the good things and act righteously. Indeed I know best what you do.
verses.transliteration_html: Ya ayyuha alrrusulu kuloo mina alttayyibati waiAAmaloo salihan innee bima taAAmaloona AAaleemun
verses.transliteration_text: Ya ayyuha alrrusulu kuloo mina alttayyibati waiAAmaloo salihan innee bima taAAmaloona AAaleemun

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّ هَـٰذِهِۦٓ أُمَّتُكُمْ أُمَّةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ وَأَنَا۠ رَبُّكُمْ فَٱتَّقُونِ
verses.english: Indeed this community of yours is one community, and I am your Lord, so be wary of Me.
verses.transliteration_html: Wainna hathihi ommatukum ommatan wahidatan waana rabbukum faittaqooni
verses.transliteration_text: Wainna hathihi ommatukum ommatan wahidatan waana rabbukum faittaqooni

verses.arabic: فَتَقَطَّعُوٓا۟ أَمْرَهُم بَيْنَهُمْ زُبُرًۭا ۖ كُلُّ حِزْبٍۭ بِمَا لَدَيْهِمْ فَرِحُونَ
verses.english: But they fragmented their religion among themselves, each party boasting about what it had.
verses.transliteration_html: FataqattaAAoo amrahum baynahum zuburan kullu hizbin bima ladayhim farihoona
verses.transliteration_text: FataqattaAAoo amrahum baynahum zuburan kullu hizbin bima ladayhim farihoona

verses.arabic: فَذَرْهُمْ فِى غَمْرَتِهِمْ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍ
verses.english: So leave them in their stupor for a while.
verses.transliteration_html: Fatharhum fee ghamratihim hatta heenin
verses.transliteration_text: Fatharhum fee ghamratihim hatta heenin

verses.arabic: أَيَحْسَبُونَ أَنَّمَا نُمِدُّهُم بِهِۦ مِن مَّالٍۢ وَبَنِينَ
verses.english: Do they suppose that whatever aid We provide them in regard to wealth and children [is because]
verses.transliteration_html: Ayahsaboona annama numidduhum bihi min malin wabaneena
verses.transliteration_text: Ayahsaboona annama numidduhum bihi min malin wabaneena

verses.arabic: نُسَارِعُ لَهُمْ فِى ٱلْخَيْرَٰتِ ۚ بَل لَّا يَشْعُرُونَ
verses.english: We are eager to bring them good? No, they are not aware!
verses.transliteration_html: NusariAAu lahum fee alkhayrati bal la yashAAuroona
verses.transliteration_text: NusariAAu lahum fee alkhayrati bal la yashAAuroona

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ هُم مِّنْ خَشْيَةِ رَبِّهِم مُّشْفِقُونَ
verses.english: Indeed those who are apprehensive for the fear of their Lord,
verses.transliteration_html: Inna allatheena hum min khashyati rabbihim mushfiqoona
verses.transliteration_text: Inna allatheena hum min khashyati rabbihim mushfiqoona

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُم بِـَٔايَـٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ يُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.english: and believe in the signs of their Lord,
verses.transliteration_html: Waallatheena hum biayati rabbihim yuminoona
verses.transliteration_text: Waallatheena hum biayati rabbihim yuminoona

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُم بِرَبِّهِمْ لَا يُشْرِكُونَ
verses.english: and do not ascribe partners to their Lord;
verses.transliteration_html: Waallatheena hum birabbihim la yushrikoona
verses.transliteration_text: Waallatheena hum birabbihim la yushrikoona

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ يُؤْتُونَ مَآ ءَاتَوا۟ وَّقُلُوبُهُمْ وَجِلَةٌ أَنَّهُمْ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ رَٰجِعُونَ
verses.english: who give whatever they give while their hearts tremble with awe that they are going to return to their Lord
verses.transliteration_html: Waallatheena yutoona ma ataw waquloobuhum wajilatun annahum ila rabbihim rajiAAoona
verses.transliteration_text: Waallatheena yutoona ma ataw waquloobuhum wajilatun annahum ila rabbihim rajiAAoona

verses.arabic: أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ يُسَـٰرِعُونَ فِى ٱلْخَيْرَٰتِ وَهُمْ لَهَا سَـٰبِقُونَ
verses.english: —it is they who are zealous in [performing] good works and take the lead in them.
verses.transliteration_html: Olaika yusariAAoona fee alkhayrati wahum laha sabiqoona
verses.transliteration_text: Olaika yusariAAoona fee alkhayrati wahum laha sabiqoona

verses.arabic: وَلَا نُكَلِّفُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا ۖ وَلَدَيْنَا كِتَـٰبٌۭ يَنطِقُ بِٱلْحَقِّ ۚ وَهُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُونَ
verses.english: We task no soul except according to its capacity, and with Us is a book that speaks the truth, and they will not be wronged.
verses.transliteration_html: Wala nukallifu nafsan illa wusAAaha waladayna kitabun yantiqu bialhaqqi wahum la yuthlamoona
verses.transliteration_text: Wala nukallifu nafsan illa wusAAaha waladayna kitabun yantiqu bialhaqqi wahum la yuthlamoona

verses.arabic: بَلْ قُلُوبُهُمْ فِى غَمْرَةٍۢ مِّنْ هَـٰذَا وَلَهُمْ أَعْمَـٰلٌۭ مِّن دُونِ ذَٰلِكَ هُمْ لَهَا عَـٰمِلُونَ
verses.english: Indeed, their hearts are in a stupor in regard to this, and there are other deeds besides which they perpetrate.
verses.transliteration_html: Bal quloobuhum fee ghamratin min hatha walahum aAAmalun min dooni thalika hum laha AAamiloona
verses.transliteration_text: Bal quloobuhum fee ghamratin min hatha walahum aAAmalun min dooni thalika hum laha AAamiloona

verses.arabic: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَآ أَخَذْنَا مُتْرَفِيهِم بِٱلْعَذَابِ إِذَا هُمْ يَجْـَٔرُونَ
verses.english: When We seize their affluent ones with punishment, behold, they make entreaties [to Us].
verses.transliteration_html: Hatta itha akhathna mutrafeehim bialAAathabi itha hum yajaroona
verses.transliteration_text: Hatta itha akhathna mutrafeehim bialAAathabi itha hum yajaroona

verses.arabic: لَا تَجْـَٔرُوا۟ ٱلْيَوْمَ ۖ إِنَّكُم مِّنَّا لَا تُنصَرُونَ
verses.english: ‘Do not make entreaties today! Indeed, you will not receive any help from Us.
verses.transliteration_html: La tajaroo alyawma innakum minna la tunsaroona
verses.transliteration_text: La tajaroo alyawma innakum minna la tunsaroona

verses.arabic: قَدْ كَانَتْ ءَايَـٰتِى تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْكُمْ فَكُنتُمْ عَلَىٰٓ أَعْقَـٰبِكُمْ تَنكِصُونَ
verses.english: Certainly My signs used to be recited to you, but you used to take to your heels,
verses.transliteration_html: Qad kanat ayatee tutla AAalaykum fakuntum AAala aAAqabikum tankisoona
verses.transliteration_text: Qad kanat ayatee tutla AAalaykum fakuntum AAala aAAqabikum tankisoona

verses.arabic: مُسْتَكْبِرِينَ بِهِۦ سَـٰمِرًۭا تَهْجُرُونَ
verses.english: being disdainful of it, talking nonsense in your nightly sessions.’
verses.transliteration_html: Mustakbireena bihi samiran tahjuroona
verses.transliteration_text: Mustakbireena bihi samiran tahjuroona

verses.arabic: أَفَلَمْ يَدَّبَّرُوا۟ ٱلْقَوْلَ أَمْ جَآءَهُم مَّا لَمْ يَأْتِ ءَابَآءَهُمُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
verses.english: Have they not contemplated the Discourse, or has anything come to them [in it] that did not come to their forefathers?
verses.transliteration_html: Afalam yaddabbaroo alqawla am jaahum ma lam yati abaahumu alawwaleena
verses.transliteration_text: Afalam yaddabbaroo alqawla am jaahum ma lam yati abaahumu alawwaleena

verses.arabic: أَمْ لَمْ يَعْرِفُوا۟ رَسُولَهُمْ فَهُمْ لَهُۥ مُنكِرُونَ
verses.english: Is it that they do not recognize their apostle, and so they deny him?
verses.transliteration_html: Am lam yaAArifoo rasoolahum fahum lahu munkiroona
verses.transliteration_text: Am lam yaAArifoo rasoolahum fahum lahu munkiroona

verses.arabic: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ بِهِۦ جِنَّةٌۢ ۚ بَلْ جَآءَهُم بِٱلْحَقِّ وَأَكْثَرُهُمْ لِلْحَقِّ كَـٰرِهُونَ
verses.english: Do they say, ‘There is madness in him’? No, he has brought them the truth, and most of them are averse to the truth.
verses.transliteration_html: Am yaqooloona bihi jinnatun bal jaahum bialhaqqi waaktharuhum lilhaqqi karihoona
verses.transliteration_text: Am yaqooloona bihi jinnatun bal jaahum bialhaqqi waaktharuhum lilhaqqi karihoona

verses.arabic: وَلَوِ ٱتَّبَعَ ٱلْحَقُّ أَهْوَآءَهُمْ لَفَسَدَتِ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتُ وَٱلْأَرْضُ وَمَن فِيهِنَّ ۚ بَلْ أَتَيْنَـٰهُم بِذِكْرِهِمْ فَهُمْ عَن ذِكْرِهِم مُّعْرِضُونَ
verses.english: Had the truth followed their desires, the heavens and the earth would have surely fallen apart [along] with those who are in them. Indeed, We have brought them their Reminder, but they are disregardful of their Reminder.
verses.transliteration_html: Walawi ittabaAAa alhaqqu ahwaahum lafasadati alssamawatu waalardu waman feehinna bal ataynahum bithikrihim fahum AAan thikrihim muAAridoona
verses.transliteration_text: Walawi ittabaAAa alhaqqu ahwaahum lafasadati alssamawatu waalardu waman feehinna bal ataynahum bithikrihim fahum AAan thikrihim muAAridoona

verses.arabic: أَمْ تَسْـَٔلُهُمْ خَرْجًۭا فَخَرَاجُ رَبِّكَ خَيْرٌۭ ۖ وَهُوَ خَيْرُ ٱلرَّٰزِقِينَ
verses.english: Do you ask a recompense from them? Your Lord’s recompense is better, and He is the best of providers.
verses.transliteration_html: Am tasaluhum kharjan fakharaju rabbika khayrun wahuwa khayru alrraziqeena
verses.transliteration_text: Am tasaluhum kharjan fakharaju rabbika khayrun wahuwa khayru alrraziqeena

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّكَ لَتَدْعُوهُمْ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍۢ مُّسْتَقِيمٍۢ
verses.english: Indeed you invite them to a straight path,
verses.transliteration_html: Wainnaka latadAAoohum ila siratin mustaqeemin
verses.transliteration_text: Wainnaka latadAAoohum ila siratin mustaqeemin

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ عَنِ ٱلصِّرَٰطِ لَنَـٰكِبُونَ
verses.english: and those who do not believe in the Hereafter surely deviate from the path.
verses.transliteration_html: Wainna allatheena la yuminoona bialakhirati AAani alssirati lanakiboona
verses.transliteration_text: Wainna allatheena la yuminoona bialakhirati AAani alssirati lanakiboona

verses.arabic: ۞ وَلَوْ رَحِمْنَـٰهُمْ وَكَشَفْنَا مَا بِهِم مِّن ضُرٍّۢ لَّلَجُّوا۟ فِى طُغْيَـٰنِهِمْ يَعْمَهُونَ
verses.english: Should We have mercy upon them and remove their distress, they would surely persist, bewildered in their rebellion.
verses.transliteration_html: Walaw rahimnahum wakashafna ma bihim min durrin lalajjoo fee tughyanihim yaAAmahoona
verses.transliteration_text: Walaw rahimnahum wakashafna ma bihim min durrin lalajjoo fee tughyanihim yaAAmahoona

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَخَذْنَـٰهُم بِٱلْعَذَابِ فَمَا ٱسْتَكَانُوا۟ لِرَبِّهِمْ وَمَا يَتَضَرَّعُونَ
verses.english: We have already seized them with punishment, yet they did not humble themselves before their Lord, nor will they entreat [Him for mercy]
verses.transliteration_html: Walaqad akhathnahum bialAAathabi fama istakanoo lirabbihim wama yatadarraAAoona
verses.transliteration_text: Walaqad akhathnahum bialAAathabi fama istakanoo lirabbihim wama yatadarraAAoona

verses.arabic: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا فَتَحْنَا عَلَيْهِم بَابًۭا ذَا عَذَابٍۢ شَدِيدٍ إِذَا هُمْ فِيهِ مُبْلِسُونَ
verses.english: until We open on them the gate of a severe punishment, whereupon they will be despondent in it.
verses.transliteration_html: Hatta itha fatahna AAalayhim baban tha AAathabin shadeedin itha hum feehi mublisoona
verses.transliteration_text: Hatta itha fatahna AAalayhim baban tha AAathabin shadeedin itha hum feehi mublisoona

verses.arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنشَأَ لَكُمُ ٱلسَّمْعَ وَٱلْأَبْصَـٰرَ وَٱلْأَفْـِٔدَةَ ۚ قَلِيلًۭا مَّا تَشْكُرُونَ
verses.english: It is He who made for you hearing, eyesight, and hearts. Little do you thank.
verses.transliteration_html: Wahuwa allathee anshaa lakumu alssamAAa waalabsara waalafidata qaleelan ma tashkuroona
verses.transliteration_text: Wahuwa allathee anshaa lakumu alssamAAa waalabsara waalafidata qaleelan ma tashkuroona

verses.arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى ذَرَأَكُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَإِلَيْهِ تُحْشَرُونَ
verses.english: It is He who created you on the earth, and you will be mustered toward Him.
verses.transliteration_html: Wahuwa allathee tharaakum fee alardi wailayhi tuhsharoona
verses.transliteration_text: Wahuwa allathee tharaakum fee alardi wailayhi tuhsharoona

verses.arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى يُحْىِۦ وَيُمِيتُ وَلَهُ ٱخْتِلَـٰفُ ٱلَّيْلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِ ۚ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ
verses.english: And it is He who gives life and brings death, and due to Him is the alternation of day and night. Do you not exercise your reason?
verses.transliteration_html: Wahuwa allathee yuhyee wayumeetu walahu ikhtilafu allayli waalnnahari afala taAAqiloona
verses.transliteration_text: Wahuwa allathee yuhyee wayumeetu walahu ikhtilafu allayli waalnnahari afala taAAqiloona

verses.arabic: بَلْ قَالُوا۟ مِثْلَ مَا قَالَ ٱلْأَوَّلُونَ
verses.english: Indeed, they say, just like what the former peoples said.
verses.transliteration_html: Bal qaloo mithla ma qala alawwaloona
verses.transliteration_text: Bal qaloo mithla ma qala alawwaloona

verses.arabic: قَالُوٓا۟ أَءِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًۭا وَعِظَـٰمًا أَءِنَّا لَمَبْعُوثُونَ
verses.english: They said, ‘What, when we are dead and become dust and bones, shall we be resurrected?
verses.transliteration_html: Qaloo aitha mitna wakunna turaban waAAithaman ainna lamabAAoothoona
verses.transliteration_text: Qaloo aitha mitna wakunna turaban waAAithaman ainna lamabAAoothoona

verses.arabic: لَقَدْ وُعِدْنَا نَحْنُ وَءَابَآؤُنَا هَـٰذَا مِن قَبْلُ إِنْ هَـٰذَآ إِلَّآ أَسَـٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
verses.english: Certainly, we and our fathers were promised this before. [But] these are nothing but myths of the ancients.’
verses.transliteration_html: Laqad wuAAidna nahnu waabaona hatha min qablu in hatha illa asateeru alawwaleena
verses.transliteration_text: Laqad wuAAidna nahnu waabaona hatha min qablu in hatha illa asateeru alawwaleena

verses.arabic: قُل لِّمَنِ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَمَن فِيهَآ إِن كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
verses.english: Say, ‘To whom does the earth belong and whoever it contains, if you know?’
verses.transliteration_html: Qul limani alardu waman feeha in kuntum taAAlamoona
verses.transliteration_text: Qul limani alardu waman feeha in kuntum taAAlamoona

verses.arabic: سَيَقُولُونَ لِلَّهِ ۚ قُلْ أَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ
verses.english: They will say, ‘To Allah.’ Say, ‘Will you not then take admonition?’
verses.transliteration_html: Sayaqooloona lillahi qul afala tathakkaroona
verses.transliteration_text: Sayaqooloona lillahi qul afala tathakkaroona

verses.arabic: قُلْ مَن رَّبُّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ ٱلسَّبْعِ وَرَبُّ ٱلْعَرْشِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
verses.english: Say, ‘Who is the Lord of the seven heavens and the Lord of the Great Throne?’
verses.transliteration_html: Qul man rabbu alssamawati alssabAAi warabbu alAAarshi alAAatheemi
verses.transliteration_text: Qul man rabbu alssamawati alssabAAi warabbu alAAarshi alAAatheemi

verses.arabic: سَيَقُولُونَ لِلَّهِ ۚ قُلْ أَفَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
verses.english: They will say, ‘[They belong] to Allah.’ Say, ‘Will you not then be wary [of Him]?’
verses.transliteration_html: Sayaqooloona lillahi qul afala tattaqoona
verses.transliteration_text: Sayaqooloona lillahi qul afala tattaqoona

verses.arabic: قُلْ مَنۢ بِيَدِهِۦ مَلَكُوتُ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ وَهُوَ يُجِيرُ وَلَا يُجَارُ عَلَيْهِ إِن كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
verses.english: Say, ‘In whose hand is the dominion of all things, and who gives shelter and no shelter can be provided from Him, if you know?’
verses.transliteration_html: Qul man biyadihi malakootu kulli shayin wahuwa yujeeru wala yujaru AAalayhi in kuntum taAAlamoona
verses.transliteration_text: Qul man biyadihi malakootu kulli shayin wahuwa yujeeru wala yujaru AAalayhi in kuntum taAAlamoona

verses.arabic: سَيَقُولُونَ لِلَّهِ ۚ قُلْ فَأَنَّىٰ تُسْحَرُونَ
verses.english: They will say, ‘[They all belong] to Allah.’ Say, ‘Then how are you so deluded?’
verses.transliteration_html: Sayaqooloona lillahi qul faanna tusharoona
verses.transliteration_text: Sayaqooloona lillahi qul faanna tusharoona

verses.arabic: بَلْ أَتَيْنَـٰهُم بِٱلْحَقِّ وَإِنَّهُمْ لَكَـٰذِبُونَ
verses.english: Indeed, We have brought them the truth, and they are indeed liars.
verses.transliteration_html: Bal ataynahum bialhaqqi wainnahum lakathiboona
verses.transliteration_text: Bal ataynahum bialhaqqi wainnahum lakathiboona

verses.arabic: مَا ٱتَّخَذَ ٱللَّهُ مِن وَلَدٍۢ وَمَا كَانَ مَعَهُۥ مِنْ إِلَـٰهٍ ۚ إِذًۭا لَّذَهَبَ كُلُّ إِلَـٰهٍۭ بِمَا خَلَقَ وَلَعَلَا بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍۢ ۚ سُبْحَـٰنَ ٱللَّهِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ
verses.english: Allah has not taken any offspring, neither is there any god besides Him, for then each god would take away what he created, and some of them would surely rise up against others. Clear is Allah of what they allege!
verses.transliteration_html: Ma ittakhatha Allahu min waladin wama kana maAAahu min ilahin ithan lathahaba kullu ilahin bima khalaqa walaAAala baAAduhum AAala baAAdin subhana Allahi AAamma yasifoona
verses.transliteration_text: Ma ittakhatha Allahu min waladin wama kana maAAahu min ilahin ithan lathahaba kullu ilahin bima khalaqa walaAAala baAAduhum AAala baAAdin subhana Allahi AAamma yasifoona

verses.arabic: عَـٰلِمِ ٱلْغَيْبِ وَٱلشَّهَـٰدَةِ فَتَعَـٰلَىٰ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ
verses.english: The Knower of the sensible and the Unseen, He is above having any partners that they ascribe [to Him].
verses.transliteration_html: AAalimi alghaybi waalshshahadati fataAAala AAamma yushrikoona
verses.transliteration_text: AAalimi alghaybi waalshshahadati fataAAala AAamma yushrikoona

verses.arabic: قُل رَّبِّ إِمَّا تُرِيَنِّى مَا يُوعَدُونَ
verses.english: Say, ‘My Lord! If You should show me what they are promised,
verses.transliteration_html: Qul rabbi imma turiyannee ma yooAAadoona
verses.transliteration_text: Qul rabbi imma turiyannee ma yooAAadoona

verses.arabic: رَبِّ فَلَا تَجْعَلْنِى فِى ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
verses.english: then do not put me, my Lord, among the wrongdoing lot.’
verses.transliteration_html: Rabbi fala tajAAalnee fee alqawmi alththalimeena
verses.transliteration_text: Rabbi fala tajAAalnee fee alqawmi alththalimeena

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّا عَلَىٰٓ أَن نُّرِيَكَ مَا نَعِدُهُمْ لَقَـٰدِرُونَ
verses.english: We are indeed able to show you what We promise them.
verses.transliteration_html: Wainna AAala an nuriyaka ma naAAiduhum laqadiroona
verses.transliteration_text: Wainna AAala an nuriyaka ma naAAiduhum laqadiroona

verses.arabic: ٱدْفَعْ بِٱلَّتِى هِىَ أَحْسَنُ ٱلسَّيِّئَةَ ۚ نَحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يَصِفُونَ
verses.english: Repel ill [conduct] with that which is the best. We know best whatever they allege.
verses.transliteration_html: IdfaAA biallatee hiya ahsanu alssayyiata nahnu aAAlamu bima yasifoona
verses.transliteration_text: IdfaAA biallatee hiya ahsanu alssayyiata nahnu aAAlamu bima yasifoona

verses.arabic: وَقُل رَّبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ هَمَزَٰتِ ٱلشَّيَـٰطِينِ
verses.english: Say, ‘My Lord! I seek Your protection from the promptings of devils,
verses.transliteration_html: Waqul rabbi aAAoothu bika min hamazati alshshayateeni
verses.transliteration_text: Waqul rabbi aAAoothu bika min hamazati alshshayateeni

verses.arabic: وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ رَبِّ أَن يَحْضُرُونِ
verses.english: and I seek Your protection, my Lord, from their presence near me.’
verses.transliteration_html: WaaAAoothu bika rabbi an yahdurooni
verses.transliteration_text: WaaAAoothu bika rabbi an yahdurooni

verses.arabic: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَآءَ أَحَدَهُمُ ٱلْمَوْتُ قَالَ رَبِّ ٱرْجِعُونِ
verses.english: When death comes to one of them, he says, ‘My Lord! Take me back,
verses.transliteration_html: Hatta itha jaa ahadahumu almawtu qala rabbi irjiAAooni
verses.transliteration_text: Hatta itha jaa ahadahumu almawtu qala rabbi irjiAAooni

verses.arabic: لَعَلِّىٓ أَعْمَلُ صَـٰلِحًۭا فِيمَا تَرَكْتُ ۚ كَلَّآ ۚ إِنَّهَا كَلِمَةٌ هُوَ قَآئِلُهَا ۖ وَمِن وَرَآئِهِم بَرْزَخٌ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ
verses.english: that I may act righteously in what I have left behind.’ ‘By no means! These are mere words that he says.’ And before them is a barrier until the day they will be resurrected.
verses.transliteration_html: LaAAallee aAAmalu salihan feema taraktu kalla innaha kalimatun huwa qailuha wamin waraihim barzakhun ila yawmi yubAAathoona
verses.transliteration_text: LaAAallee aAAmalu salihan feema taraktu kalla innaha kalimatun huwa qailuha wamin waraihim barzakhun ila yawmi yubAAathoona

verses.arabic: فَإِذَا نُفِخَ فِى ٱلصُّورِ فَلَآ أَنسَابَ بَيْنَهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ وَلَا يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
verses.english: When the Trumpet is blown, there will be no ties between them on that day, nor will they ask [about] each other.
verses.transliteration_html: Faitha nufikha fee alssoori fala ansaba baynahum yawmaithin wala yatasaaloona
verses.transliteration_text: Faitha nufikha fee alssoori fala ansaba baynahum yawmaithin wala yatasaaloona

verses.arabic: فَمَن ثَقُلَتْ مَوَٰزِينُهُۥ فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْمُفْلِحُونَ
verses.english: Then those whose deeds weigh heavy in the scales—it is they who are the felicitous.
verses.transliteration_html: Faman thaqulat mawazeenuhu faolaika humu almuflihoona
verses.transliteration_text: Faman thaqulat mawazeenuhu faolaika humu almuflihoona

verses.arabic: وَمَنْ خَفَّتْ مَوَٰزِينُهُۥ فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ خَسِرُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُمْ فِى جَهَنَّمَ خَـٰلِدُونَ
verses.english: As for those whose deeds weigh light in the scales—they will be the ones who have ruined their souls, and they will remain in hell [forever].
verses.transliteration_html: Waman khaffat mawazeenuhu faolaika allatheena khasiroo anfusahum fee jahannama khalidoona
verses.transliteration_text: Waman khaffat mawazeenuhu faolaika allatheena khasiroo anfusahum fee jahannama khalidoona

verses.arabic: تَلْفَحُ وُجُوهَهُمُ ٱلنَّارُ وَهُمْ فِيهَا كَـٰلِحُونَ
verses.english: The Fire will scorch their faces, while they snarl baring their teeth.
verses.transliteration_html: Talfahu wujoohahumu alnnaru wahum feeha kalihoona
verses.transliteration_text: Talfahu wujoohahumu alnnaru wahum feeha kalihoona

verses.arabic: أَلَمْ تَكُنْ ءَايَـٰتِى تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْكُمْ فَكُنتُم بِهَا تُكَذِّبُونَ
verses.english: ‘Was it not that My signs were recited to you but you would deny them?’
verses.transliteration_html: Alam takun ayatee tutla AAalaykum fakuntum biha tukaththiboona
verses.transliteration_text: Alam takun ayatee tutla AAalaykum fakuntum biha tukaththiboona

verses.arabic: قَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَا غَلَبَتْ عَلَيْنَا شِقْوَتُنَا وَكُنَّا قَوْمًۭا ضَآلِّينَ
verses.english: They will say, ‘Our Lord! Our wretchedness overcame us, and we were an astray lot.
verses.transliteration_html: Qaloo rabbana ghalabat AAalayna shiqwatuna wakunna qawman dalleena
verses.transliteration_text: Qaloo rabbana ghalabat AAalayna shiqwatuna wakunna qawman dalleena

verses.arabic: رَبَّنَآ أَخْرِجْنَا مِنْهَا فَإِنْ عُدْنَا فَإِنَّا ظَـٰلِمُونَ
verses.english: Our Lord! Bring us out of this! Then, if we revert [to our previous conduct], we will indeed be wrongdoers.’
verses.transliteration_html: Rabbana akhrijna minha fain AAudna fainna thalimoona
verses.transliteration_text: Rabbana akhrijna minha fain AAudna fainna thalimoona

verses.arabic: قَالَ ٱخْسَـُٔوا۟ فِيهَا وَلَا تُكَلِّمُونِ
verses.english: He will say, ‘Begone in it, and do not speak to Me!
verses.transliteration_html: Qala ikhsaoo feeha wala tukallimooni
verses.transliteration_text: Qala ikhsaoo feeha wala tukallimooni

verses.arabic: إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ فَرِيقٌۭ مِّنْ عِبَادِى يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَآ ءَامَنَّا فَٱغْفِرْ لَنَا وَٱرْحَمْنَا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ ٱلرَّٰحِمِينَ
verses.english: Indeed there was a part of My servants who would say, ‘‘Our Lord! We have believed. So forgive us, and have mercy on us, and You are the best of the merciful.’’
verses.transliteration_html: Innahu kana fareequn min AAibadee yaqooloona rabbana amanna faighfir lana wairhamna waanta khayru alrrahimeena
verses.transliteration_text: Innahu kana fareequn min AAibadee yaqooloona rabbana amanna faighfir lana wairhamna waanta khayru alrrahimeena

verses.arabic: فَٱتَّخَذْتُمُوهُمْ سِخْرِيًّا حَتَّىٰٓ أَنسَوْكُمْ ذِكْرِى وَكُنتُم مِّنْهُمْ تَضْحَكُونَ
verses.english: But you took them by ridicule until they made you forget My remembrance, and you used to laugh at them.
verses.transliteration_html: Faittakhathtumoohum sikhriyyan hatta ansawkum thikree wakuntum minhum tadhakoona
verses.transliteration_text: Faittakhathtumoohum sikhriyyan hatta ansawkum thikree wakuntum minhum tadhakoona

verses.arabic: إِنِّى جَزَيْتُهُمُ ٱلْيَوْمَ بِمَا صَبَرُوٓا۟ أَنَّهُمْ هُمُ ٱلْفَآئِزُونَ
verses.english: Indeed I have rewarded them today for their patience. They are indeed the triumphant.’
verses.transliteration_html: Innee jazaytuhumu alyawma bima sabaroo annahum humu alfaizoona
verses.transliteration_text: Innee jazaytuhumu alyawma bima sabaroo annahum humu alfaizoona

verses.arabic: قَـٰلَ كَمْ لَبِثْتُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ عَدَدَ سِنِينَ
verses.english: He will say, ‘How many years did you remain on earth?’
verses.transliteration_html: Qala kam labithtum fee alardi AAadada sineena
verses.transliteration_text: Qala kam labithtum fee alardi AAadada sineena

verses.arabic: قَالُوا۟ لَبِثْنَا يَوْمًا أَوْ بَعْضَ يَوْمٍۢ فَسْـَٔلِ ٱلْعَآدِّينَ
verses.english: They will say, ‘We remained for a day, or part of a day; yet ask those who keep the count.’
verses.transliteration_html: Qaloo labithna yawman aw baAAda yawmin faisali alAAaddeena
verses.transliteration_text: Qaloo labithna yawman aw baAAda yawmin faisali alAAaddeena

verses.arabic: قَـٰلَ إِن لَّبِثْتُمْ إِلَّا قَلِيلًۭا ۖ لَّوْ أَنَّكُمْ كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
verses.english: He will say, ‘You only remained a little; if only you had known.
verses.transliteration_html: Qala in labithtum illa qaleelan law annakum kuntum taAAlamoona
verses.transliteration_text: Qala in labithtum illa qaleelan law annakum kuntum taAAlamoona

verses.arabic: أَفَحَسِبْتُمْ أَنَّمَا خَلَقْنَـٰكُمْ عَبَثًۭا وَأَنَّكُمْ إِلَيْنَا لَا تُرْجَعُونَ
verses.english: Did you suppose that We created you aimlessly, and that you will not be brought back to Us?’
verses.transliteration_html: Afahasibtum annama khalaqnakum AAabathan waannakum ilayna la turjaAAoona
verses.transliteration_text: Afahasibtum annama khalaqnakum AAabathan waannakum ilayna la turjaAAoona

verses.arabic: فَتَعَـٰلَى ٱللَّهُ ٱلْمَلِكُ ٱلْحَقُّ ۖ لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ رَبُّ ٱلْعَرْشِ ٱلْكَرِيمِ
verses.english: So exalted is Allah, the True Sovereign, there is no god except Him, the Lord of the Noble Throne.
verses.transliteration_html: FataAAala Allahu almaliku alhaqqu la ilaha illa huwa rabbu alAAarshi alkareemi
verses.transliteration_text: FataAAala Allahu almaliku alhaqqu la ilaha illa huwa rabbu alAAarshi alkareemi

verses.arabic: وَمَن يَدْعُ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَـٰهًا ءَاخَرَ لَا بُرْهَـٰنَ لَهُۥ بِهِۦ فَإِنَّمَا حِسَابُهُۥ عِندَ رَبِّهِۦٓ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ لَا يُفْلِحُ ٱلْكَـٰفِرُونَ
verses.english: Whoever invokes besides Allah another god of which he has no proof, his reckoning will indeed rest with his Lord. Indeed the faithless will not be felicitous.
verses.transliteration_html: Waman yadAAu maAAa Allahi ilahan akhara la burhana lahu bihi fainnama hisabuhu AAinda rabbihi innahu la yuflihu alkafiroona
verses.transliteration_text: Waman yadAAu maAAa Allahi ilahan akhara la burhana lahu bihi fainnama hisabuhu AAinda rabbihi innahu la yuflihu alkafiroona

verses.arabic: وَقُل رَّبِّ ٱغْفِرْ وَٱرْحَمْ وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ ٱلرَّٰحِمِينَ
verses.english: Say, ‘My Lord, forgive and have mercy, and You are the best of the merciful.’
verses.transliteration_html: Waqul rabbi ighfir wairham waanta khayru alrrahimeena
verses.transliteration_text: Waqul rabbi ighfir wairham waanta khayru alrrahimeena
